sign_in.title: Sign in to {server}
landing.title: A shared Oleafly project
landing.body: Someone on {server} shared a project with this link. Open it in Oleafly to see it.
landing.next: You need to be added by its owner, or the owner needs to turn on link sharing.
start.bad_link_body: It doesn't lead back to Oleafly. Start signing in again from Oleafly.
callback.over_title: This sign-in already finished or expired
callback.over_body: If Oleafly says you're signed in, you're all set. Otherwise go back to Oleafly and start signing in again.
code.enter: Enter the code that Oleafly shows on the device you're signing in on.
code.wrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the code Oleafly shows and try again.
code.asked: Oleafly on {device} asked to sign in with this code:
code.only_if_you: Only continue if you started this sign-in yourself, on that device. If someone sent you this link or code, stop. They're trying to get into your account.
code.other_network: This sign-in was started on a different network than this browser. Only continue if you started it yourself on another computer, such as a lab machine.
code.no_providers: This server has no way to sign in yet. Ask its admin to set one up.
code.stopped_body: Nobody can use this code now. If you meant to sign in, start again in Oleafly.
code.done_body: Go back to Oleafly on {device}. It finishes signing in by itself. You can close this tab.
code.expired_body: Start signing in again in Oleafly to get a new code.
code.refused_title: You can't sign in here yet
code.refused_email_advice: To use a different address, start again in Oleafly with one the admin added.
code.refused_provider_advice: To use a different account, sign out of {provider} in this browser, then start again in Oleafly.
code.retry: {reason} To try again, open {link} and enter the code from Oleafly.
email.enter_address: Enter your email address. We'll send you a link that signs you in to Oleafly on {device}.
email.invalid_address: Enter a valid email address, such as ada@uni.edu.
email.type_code: Type the code Oleafly shows on the computer you're signing in on.
email.only_if_you: Only continue if you started this sign-in yourself. If someone gave you a code to type, stop. They're trying to get into your account.
email.finish: Finish signing in to Oleafly on {device}.
email.page_expired_body: It was open for more than an hour, or this browser blocked its cookie. Go back to Oleafly and start signing in again.
email.sign_in_expired_body: Go back to Oleafly and start signing in again.
email.off_body: This server doesn't sign people in by email any more. Go back to Oleafly and choose another way to sign in.
email.link_used_body: Each sign-in link works once. Start signing in again in Oleafly to get a new one.
email.link_expired_body: Sign-in links work for 15 minutes. Start signing in again in Oleafly to get a new one.
email.link_invalid_body: It may be incomplete, or a newer link replaced it. Start signing in again in Oleafly to get a new one.
email.sent_body: We sent a sign-in link to {address}.
email.sent_same_device: Open it on this computer within 15 minutes. You can close this tab.
email.sent_other_device: Open it within 15 minutes and type the code Oleafly shows. You can close this tab.
auth_error.not_admitted: You're not on this server's list yet. Ask its admin to add you.
auth_error.invalid_code: The sign-in code is wrong or has expired. Sign in again.
auth_error.invalid_signature: This device couldn't prove who it is. Sign in again.
auth_error.expired_nonce: The sign-in check expired. Try again.
auth_error.invalid_redirect: That sign-in return address isn't allowed.
auth_error.unknown_provider: This server doesn't offer that sign-in option.
auth_error.provider_failed: The sign-in provider didn't finish the sign-in. Try again.
auth_error.refresh_reused: This session was used twice, so the server signed this device out. Sign in again.
auth_error.revoked: This device was signed out. Sign in again.
auth_error.setup_code_invalid: That setup code is wrong or was already used.
